legal_name.meaning: Registered legal name of the fleet business, as on its tax records.

dba_name.meaning: Name the fleet does business under; equals legal_name when it has none.

admin_name.meaning: Full name of the fleet's authorized account administrator, the person who may give instructions, sign affidavits and confirm cancellations on the account.

phone.meaning: Registered business phone number of the account.

email.meaning: Registered email address of the account administrator.

ein_last4.meaning: Last four digits of the fleet's federal Employer Identification Number on file.

billing_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the billing address on file.

customer_since.meaning: Date the customer profile was opened with Meridian.

fleet_type.meaning: Kind of organization the fleet is, as documented at onboarding; only state_local_government and nonprofit_educational can qualify for federal excise tax exempt billing.

program_id.meaning: Fleet Card Program reference; primary id.

credit_line_id.meaning: Credit line that bills the program (-> credit_lines).

program_number.meaning: Program account number printed on statements and cards.

variant_name.meaning: Official tier currently held (in effect from tier_effective_on).

prior_variant_name.meaning: Tier held before the latest tier change, in effect for dates before tier_effective_on; none when the tier was never changed.

activated_on.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
activated_on.meaning: Underwriting approval date; anchors first-cycle waivers, setup fee and early termination period. Empty while applied or when declined.

tier_effective_on.meaning: Date the current tier took effect (the application date when never changed).

closed_on.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
closed_on.meaning: Date the program closed; empty while not closed.

close_reason.meaning: Why the program closed; not_closed while open.

fet_exemption_status.meaning: Federal excise tax exempt billing status; credits are earned only while active.

fet_certificate_on.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
fet_certificate_on.meaning: Date the fleet's signed exemption certificate was received; empty when none is on file.

ifta_reporting.meaning: true while the program is enrolled in the quarterly IFTA jurisdiction fuel report.

program_txn_id.meaning: Posted purchase or merchant credit reference; primary id.

program_id.meaning: Program the purchase posted to (-> fleet_programs).

txn_ref.meaning: Merchant transaction reference printed on the statement; unique per posting.

txn_date.meaning: Date of the purchase at the site (site local), or the date the merchant issued a credit.

txn_time.format: HH:MM, 24-hour, or empty string when not set
txn_time.meaning: Site-local time the purchase was authorized; empty on merchant credits.

post_date.meaning: Date the row posted to the program; decides its fee cycle and statement cycle.

site_number.meaning: Site or merchant number; empty on merchant credits.

site_state.meaning: Two-letter US state or Canadian province code of the site; empty on merchant credits.

network.meaning: Site's network: in_network = Meridian fuel network, partner = discounting partner site, out_of_network = accepted through Mastercard outside the network.

site_service.meaning: Fueling service type; not_applicable for non-fuel rows.

gallons.meaning: Gallons dispensed or credited, always positive (0.000 for non-fuel).

unit_price.meaning: Pump price per gallon before any discount (0.000 for non-fuel).

gross_amount.meaning: Gross amount, positive: gallons x unit_price rounded half up for fuel; the purchase amount for non-fuel; the gross credited on a credit.

partner_discount_amount.meaning: Partner-site discount, positive or 0.00 when none applied (on a credit: the discount reversed).

net_amount.meaning: gross_amount less partner_discount_amount; the amount billed (on a credit, the amount credited), always positive.

odometer.meaning: Odometer (or hour meter) entered at the pump; 0 when not prompted or on credits.

driver_prompt_number.meaning: Driver ID entered at the pump; empty when not prompted or on credits.

entry_method.meaning: How the card was read; not_applicable on credits.

original_txn_id.meaning: On a merchant credit, the purchase credited (-> program_transactions.program_txn_id); empty string on purchases.

reversal_reason.meaning: Reason a merchant gave for its credit; not_applicable on purchases.

program_charge_id.meaning: Program fee, credit or reversal reference; primary id.

event_type.meaning: Event family of the row; fees and FET credit reversals add to charges, FET credits and fee reversals reduce them.

charge_date.meaning: Assessment or posting date; decides the statement cycle the row bills in.

cycle_start.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
cycle_start.meaning: First day of the fee cycle (calendar month) or calendar quarter the row covers; empty for one-time rows.

cycle_end.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
cycle_end.meaning: Last day of that fee cycle or quarter; empty for one-time rows.

related_txn_id.meaning: Purchase (or, on a FET credit reversal, the merchant credit) the row belongs to (-> program_transactions.program_txn_id); empty string for cycle and one-time rows.

active_card_count.meaning: Card fee rows: cards counted for the cycle; 0 on other rows.

billed_card_count.meaning: Card fee rows: counted cards less fee-free cards, never below 0; 0 on other rows.

unit_amount.meaning: Card fee rows: per-card fee in USD; intl fee rows: percent applied; FET rows: USD per gallon rate; 0.000 elsewhere.

gallons.meaning: Monthly fee rows: billed gallons of the cycle; FET rows: gallons credited or offset; 0.000 elsewhere.

amount.meaning: Amount of the row, always positive or 0.00; the event_type gives the direction. 0.00 is recorded only where the charter says a row is written at 0.00 (capped or waived per-transaction fees, a card fee cycle with no billed card).

original_charge_id.meaning: On a fee reversal or FET credit reversal, the row reversed (-> program_charges.program_charge_id); empty string otherwise.

reversal_reason.meaning: Reason for a fee reversal; not_applicable on other rows.

credit_line_id.meaning: Commercial credit line reference; primary id.

credit_limit.meaning: Permanent credit limit set by underwriting.

temp_limit_increase.meaning: Temporary increase in force through temp_limit_expires_on; 0.00 when none.

temp_limit_expires_on.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
temp_limit_expires_on.meaning: Last day the temporary increase is in force; empty when none.

payment_terms_days.meaning: Calendar days from statement date to due date for the cycle in force.

autopay_enrolled.meaning: true while ACH autopay is on.

wire_only_until.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
wire_only_until.meaning: Last day payments must be made by wire after returned payments; empty when no requirement is in force.

current_balance.meaning: Amount owed now: running sum of the outstanding_balance account (statement billed amounts, credit fees and returned payments in; payments and fee reversals out); negative means a credit balance.

security_deposit_held.meaning: Security deposit held now: running sum of the security_deposit account; 0.00 when none.

approved_on.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
approved_on.meaning: Approval date; empty while applied or when declined.

last_review_on.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
last_review_on.meaning: Date of the latest credit review or limit change; empty before approval.

closed_on.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
closed_on.meaning: Closure date; empty while not closed.

close_reason.meaning: Why the line closed; not_closed while open.

credit_line_id.meaning: Line the statement is for (-> credit_lines).

billing_cycle.meaning: Cycle in force for this statement.

due_date.meaning: statement_date plus payment_terms_days, calendar days, no weekend or holiday move.

previous_balance.meaning: new_balance of the previous statement; 0.00 for the first; may be negative.

payments_amount.meaning: Payments posted in the cycle less payments returned in the cycle; may be negative.

purchases_amount.meaning: Net purchases (purchases less merchant credits) posted in the cycle across all programs; may be negative.

program_fees_amount.meaning: Program fees less fee reversals and federal excise tax credits (plus FET credit reversals) posted in the cycle; may be negative.

card_fees_amount.meaning: Card fees less card fee reversals posted in the cycle; may be negative.

maint_amount.meaning: Maintenance charges less maintenance credits and reversals posted in the cycle; may be negative.

dispute_credits_amount.meaning: Dispute credits less provisional credit reversals posted in the cycle; positive reduces the bill, negative raises it.

rebate_credits_amount.meaning: Rebate credits whose rebate entry names this statement; 0.00 when none.

billed_amount.meaning: purchases + program fees + card fees + maintenance - dispute credits - rebate credits; may be negative.

credit_fees_amount.meaning: Late, returned-payment and paper statement fees less their reversals posted in the cycle; may be negative.

new_balance.meaning: previous_balance - payments_amount + billed_amount + credit_fees_amount; the full amount due by due_date.

past_due_amount.meaning: Information line: unpaid past-due amount of the previous statement at this statement date; 0.00 when none.

credit_entry_id.meaning: Credit ledger entry reference; primary id.

event_type.meaning: Event family; the charter gives each family's account and direction.

statement_id.meaning: Late and paper statement fees: the statement concerned (-> credit_statements); empty string on other entries.

amount.meaning: Amount of the entry, always positive; the event_type gives the direction.

basis_amount.meaning: Late fees: past-due amount the fee was figured on; deposits received: deposit required at the time; 0.00 elsewhere.

payment_ref.meaning: Payments and deposits: confirmation or trace number of the payment exactly as issued by the portal or bank; empty elsewhere.

payment_method.meaning: How a payment or deposit was made; not_applicable on fee and return entries.

return_code.meaning: Returned payments: ACH return reason (R01 insufficient funds, R02 account closed, R08 payment stopped, R10 unauthorized) or check_returned; not_applicable elsewhere.

original_entry_id.meaning: Payment returns: the payment; returned-payment fees: the return; fee reversals: the fee (-> credit_ledger.credit_entry_id); empty string elsewhere.

credit_request_id.meaning: Permanent limit increase request reference; primary id.

credit_line_id.meaning: Line the request is for (-> credit_lines).

decided_on.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set

program_id.meaning: Program the card is issued under (-> fleet_programs).

control_profile_id.meaning: Purchase-control profile the card carries (-> control_profiles).

card_last4.meaning: Last four digits of the card number.

vehicle_unit_number.meaning: Fleet's unit number of the vehicle or equipment; empty on a driver card.

tank_capacity_gal.meaning: Recorded tank capacity; 0 when not recorded.

driver_name.meaning: Assigned driver's name; empty on vehicle and equipment cards.

driver_prompt_number.meaning: Driver ID prompted at the pump; empty when none.

activated_on.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
activated_on.meaning: Activation date; empty while ordered or if never activated.

suspended_on.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
suspended_on.meaning: Start date of the current hold; empty when not suspended.

expires_on.meaning: Expiry date (last day of the expiry month).

reissued_on.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
reissued_on.meaning: Date the latest renewal shipped; empty when never renewed.

replaces_card_id.meaning: Card this card replaces (-> fleet_cards.fleet_card_id); empty string on a first issue.

closed_on.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
closed_on.meaning: Date the card closed; empty while not closed.

closed_time.format: HH:MM, 24-hour, or empty string when not set
closed_time.meaning: Central time a lost/stolen report or cancellation confirmation closed the card; empty otherwise.

close_reason.meaning: Why the card closed; not_closed while open.

fleet_card_id.meaning: Card the event is on (-> fleet_cards).

event_date.meaning: Date of the event (replacement order, ship date, reversal, reset).

new_card_id.meaning: Replacements: the replacement card ordered (-> fleet_cards.fleet_card_id); empty string elsewhere.

shipping_method.meaning: Shipping fees: paid method; not_applicable elsewhere.

amount.meaning: Fee or reversal amount, positive or 0.00 (a replacement or shipping fee that a benefit or waiver makes free is recorded at 0.00); 0.00 on PIN resets.

original_event_id.meaning: Fee reversals: the fee reversed (-> card_events.card_event_id); empty string elsewhere.

pin_reset_channel.meaning: PIN resets: who reset it; not_applicable elsewhere.

program_id.meaning: Program the disputed purchase posted to (-> fleet_programs).

fleet_card_id.meaning: Card used for the purchase (-> fleet_cards).

statement_id.meaning: Statement that billed the purchase (-> credit_statements); its statement_date anchors the filing window.

values: Lost or Stolen Card Fraud Claim

status.meaning: Lifecycle status (dispute charter lifecycle); the first four are open statuses.

claimed_gallons.meaning: Quantity cases: gallons the fleet states were dispensed; 0.000 otherwise.

claimed_unit_price.meaning: Price cases: price per gallon the fleet states applied; 0.000 otherwise.

promised_credit_amount.meaning: Credit-not-processed cases: credit the merchant promised; 0.00 otherwise.

disputed_amount.meaning: Amount in dispute, positive, figured by the case type's disputed_amount_basis.

affidavit_requested_on.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
affidavit_requested_on.meaning: Date the affidavit request was sent; empty when none.

affidavit_received_on.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
affidavit_received_on.meaning: Date the signed affidavit was received; empty when none.

police_report_number.meaning: Police report number given with a lost or stolen affidavit, exactly as stated; empty when none.

review_started_on.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
review_started_on.meaning: Date a no-affidavit case moved to review; empty otherwise.

chargeback_filed_on.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
chargeback_filed_on.meaning: Mastercard chargeback filing date; empty when none.

resolved_on.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
resolved_on.meaning: Resolution, withdrawal or lapse date; empty while open.

liability.meaning: Who bears the disputed amount; pending while open (and on withdrawn cases).

dispute_entry_id.meaning: Dispute credit or reversal reference; primary id.

dispute_case_id.meaning: Case the entry belongs to (-> dispute_cases).

event_type.meaning: Event family; credits book in, reversals out.

entry_date.meaning: Posting date; decides the statement cycle the entry bills in.

amount.meaning: Amount, always positive; the event_type gives the direction.

fees_included_amount.meaning: Credits: part of amount that credits the purchase's per-transaction fees; 0.00 when none and on reversals.

original_entry_id.meaning: Reversals: the provisional credit reversed (-> dispute_entries.dispute_entry_id); empty string on credits.

prior_variant_name.meaning: Schedule held before the latest change, for months before schedule_effective_on; none when never changed.

activated_on.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
activated_on.meaning: Date earning began; empty while pending or when declined.

schedule_effective_on.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
schedule_effective_on.meaning: First day the current schedule applies; equals activated_on when never changed; empty while pending.

ended_on.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
ended_on.meaning: End date; empty while not ended.

end_reason.meaning: Why the plan ended; not_ended while open.

accrued_balance.meaning: Earned and unpaid rebate: running sum of the rebate_accrued account.

event_type.meaning: Event family; accruals and adjustments book in, the rest out.

entry_date.meaning: Posting date (for credits, the statement date of the statement credited).

period_start.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
period_start.meaning: Accruals: first day of the month; credits and payouts: first day of the settlement period; empty elsewhere.

period_end.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
period_end.meaning: Last day of that month or settlement period; empty elsewhere.

qualifying_gallons.meaning: Accruals: qualifying gallons of the month across all programs; 0.000 elsewhere.

rate_cpg.meaning: Accruals: rate applied in USD per gallon; 0.000 when the month earned nothing and on other entries.

amount.meaning: Amount, positive or 0.00 (an accrual for a month that earned nothing records 0.00); the event_type gives the direction.

statement_id.meaning: Credits: the statement credited (-> credit_statements); empty string elsewhere.

original_entry_id.meaning: Adjustments, reversals and late-payment forfeitures: the accrual concerned (-> rebate_entries.rebate_entry_id); empty string elsewhere.

program_id.meaning: Program the profile belongs to (-> fleet_programs).

profile_name.meaning: Name the administrator gave the profile.

window_start.meaning: Start of the allowed window, site local time, inclusive.

window_end.meaning: End of the allowed window, site local time, inclusive.

tank_capacity_check.meaning: true while fills above the card's tank capacity (plus tolerance) decline.

activated_on.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
activated_on.meaning: Date in force; empty while pending.

retired_on.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
retired_on.meaning: Retirement or discard date; empty otherwise.

control_event_id.meaning: Authorization decline or override reference; primary id.

event_date.meaning: Attempt date (site local) or override grant date.

event_time.meaning: Attempt time (site local) or grant time (Central).

site_number.meaning: Declines: site number; empty on overrides.

product_code.meaning: Declines: product attempted; not_applicable on overrides.

attempted_gallons.meaning: Declines: gallons requested; 0.000 for non-fuel and overrides.

decline_reason.meaning: Declines: first failing check; overrides: the decline reason lifted.

override_amount.meaning: Overrides: most the one purchase may authorize; 0.00 on declines.

override_expires_on.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
override_expires_on.meaning: Overrides: expiry date; empty on declines.

override_expires_time.format: HH:MM, 24-hour, or empty string when not set
override_expires_time.meaning: Overrides: expiry time (Central); empty on declines.

enrolled_vehicles.meaning: Vehicles enrolled (in force from the next month after a change).

activated_on.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
activated_on.meaning: Date the service took effect; empty while pending or when declined.

ended_on.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
ended_on.meaning: End date; empty while not ended.

repair_order_id.meaning: Maintenance ledger row reference; primary id.

fleet_card_id.meaning: Card of the vehicle (-> fleet_cards); empty string on fee rows.

event_type.meaning: Event family; approvals are documentary, postings and fees book in, credits and reversals out.

ro_number.meaning: Shop's repair-order or credit memo number; empty on fee rows.

ro_date.meaning: Decision, posting, assessment or reversal date.

period_start.format: YYYY-MM-DD, or empty string when not set
period_start.meaning: Service fees: first day of the month; empty elsewhere.

shop_name.meaning: Shop name; empty on fee rows.

shop_network.meaning: Shop's network; not_applicable on fee rows.

service_category.meaning: Kind of work; not_applicable on fee rows.

parts_amount.meaning: Postings: parts and tires before discount; 0.00 elsewhere.

discount_amount.meaning: Postings: network discount; 0.00 out of network and elsewhere.

amount.meaning: Amount, always positive or 0.00; the event_type gives the direction (approvals: the estimate).

approval_status.meaning: Approvals and postings: approval standing; not_applicable on fee rows.

original_order_id.meaning: Credits and reversals: the row credited or reversed (-> maint_orders.repair_order_id); empty string elsewhere.

verification_id.meaning: Identity verification record reference; primary id.

verified.meaning: Whether verification passed; never goes back from true to false.

verified_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now(): YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS <TZ>
verified_at.meaning: Moment of the latest verification attempt.

handoff_id.meaning: Human handoff record reference; primary id.

reason.meaning: Reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values.

created_at.format: timestamp exactly as returned by ctx.now(): YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS <TZ>
